reason: I got burned paying for software my staff never touched, but here I only risk ₹5,000 and the second half is paid only if my stylists actually bill in it, with my money back if not. For ₹500 a month, with someone setting it up in my salon and training staff in Odia, I'll try it, cautiously.
objection: My senior stylists will feel I'm watching them with the live chair view and the cash-drawer checks, and they'll quietly go back to the register like last time. If they feel I don't trust them I lose more than the software is worth.
would_change_my_mind: If on setup day my senior stylists push back hard and treat it as spying on them, I'd stop before paying the second half.
